attributes.name: Yaniel
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card and reveal a weapon that has the Sword trait to add 1d6+4 to a combat check by a character at your location. If the revealed weapon is Radiance, remove it from the game and replace it with the loot Holy Radiance.

Bury this card to explore your location. During this exploration, add 1d6+4 to your combat checks.
